data.summary: api/gate_baseline.py _linked dedupes only when ONE open bug's summary names every failing id, so a run whose set differs by a single test files a new 'main (sha) is red' bug even when each id already has an open bug. Measured 2026-11-05: 24 open such bugs, 22 of them naming tests red at 968df7545, against 91 distinct failing ids; their fix tasks land in bugs-2 or the item's phase, not P-green-main, so ownership of a red test cannot be read from the queue. Expected: a failing id already named by an open bug links to it; only ids with no open bug file a new one, and that bug lands in the configured main-red phase.
data.title: baseline-red auto-filer opens a new bug per failing set, 24 open for one red main

In a throwaway detached git worktree of the commit, with plain uv run: take evidence.baseline.auto.ids from the last LS-worker-lane-override unit_tests gate.partial in .ddflow/events/sw-lsoverride.jsonl, then uv run pytest -q --timeout=420 -n 12 -m '' <ids>, adding those tests' files and the tests named by open main-red bugs for the file-level run. Pass the ids through a file or script: zsh has no mapfile, and empty args run the whole suite.
